description: Candidate schema for an unpublished container of completed listens. The production namespace must publish and review this schema separately before enabling batch writes.

main.description: A container of 1–200 listens. Each entry has a stable TID id and every single-scrobble field, including its own createdAt. The envelope also has createdAt.

createdAt.description: Envelope creation time, validated against event receipt time.

id.description: Stable unique TID listen id within this container.

artist.description: One credited display string; raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming. The scalar limit is enforced by the validator.

track.description: Raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; enforced by the validator.

album.description: If present, raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; enforced by the validator.

listenedAt.description: Explicit UTC RFC3339, from 1970-01-01 through event receipt time plus 300 seconds inclusive.

createdAt.description: Explicit UTC RFC3339, from 1970-01-01 through event receipt time plus 300 seconds inclusive.

recordingMbid.description: Optional unverified recording UUID; runtime validates UUID syntax. Not a grouping key.

albumArtist.description: Optional album artist (Last.fm albumArtist, ListenBrainz release_artist_name); raw 1–256 Unicode scalar values, and nonempty after trimming; enforced by the validator.

trackNumber.description: Optional position of the track on its release.

artistMbids.description: Optional unverified MusicBrainz artist UUIDs, at most 10 and distinct; runtime validates UUID syntax.

releaseMbid.description: Optional unverified MusicBrainz release UUID; runtime validates UUID syntax.

releaseGroupMbid.description: Optional unverified MusicBrainz release-group UUID; runtime validates UUID syntax.

isrc.description: Optional ISRC, uppercase, matching ^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{3}[0-9]{7}$; enforced by the validator.

submissionClient.description: Optional name (and version) of the submitting client; raw 1–64 Unicode scalar values and at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; enforced by the validator.

musicService.description: Optional lowercase DNS name of the music service the listen came from (ListenBrainz music_service); enforced by the validator.
